deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. Folio [156r] is a printed page of a German antiquarian bookseller's sale catalogue. It is page 3 and is headed 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik'. It is not a Riemann manuscript and is not in his hand.

- **Upper part:** the end of the 'Mathematik' section, entries Wolgemuth to Zuckermandel. These include Wrede on the theory of the hydraulic ram and on differential and integral calculus, Wunder on combinations, Zimmermann, Zorer, and Zuckermandel on magic squares.
- **Lower part:** the start of the 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik' section, entries Abhandlungen to Baumgartner.
- **Entry format:** author, short title, format (4., 8., Fol.), place, year with the leading '1' dropped (e.g. 857 = 1857), binding (Ppbd., br., Hlbldrbd., Pgmtbd., cart.), original price in parentheses, and the sale price in Thaler and Silbergroschen.
- **Date:** the previous page lists items dated 860 (1860), so the catalogue was printed in or after 1860. The previous page also carries a show-through stamp of Ermanno Loescher (Turin), a bookseller.

The sheet was presumably filed with the 'MathNotizen1853' bundle, perhaps as scrap paper or as a list Riemann (or a later owner) consulted. Nothing written by Riemann is visible on this side: no annotations, no marks, no calculations. There are no derivations to reconstruct, and the purpose of any computation cannot be determined.
errors: No mathematical content, so there are no mathematical errors to report.
The printed source contains catalogue misprints, e.g. 'exangiub.' for 'exsanguib.' and 'naturel history' for 'natural history'. These belong to the printed text, not to Riemann.
